Quillmark raises EUR 12 million seed round

Quillmark has raised EUR 12 million in seed funding led by Fjord Capital, the company said on Monday.

Quillmark is headquartered in Oslo, Norway, and builds security software for logistics companies.

The Nordic software market has grown steadily as companies across the region adopt cloud tools, and investors have kept writing early cheques for teams with paying customers.

Quillmark closes seed round

Quillmark closed a EUR 15 million seed round led by Fjord Capital, according to people familiar with the deal.

The startup sells software that detects tampering in shipping containers.

The Nordic software market has grown steadily as companies across the region adopt cloud tools, and investors have kept writing early cheques for teams with paying customers.
